title: PEPSICO_2023_8K_dated-2023-05-05.pdf
summary: This section of PepsiCo's Form 8-K filing includes a preface detailing the company's registration information and compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, including its IRS identification number and registered securities. It also presents the results from the 2023 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on May 3, 2023, covering the election of 15 directors, the ratification of KPMG LLP as the independent auditor, and advisory votes on executive compensation. Additionally, it notes the defeat of several shareholder proposals, including those for an independent Board Chair and transparency reports, along with specific vote counts for each proposal.

children.title: preface
children.summary: This section serves as the preface for PepsiCo, Inc.'s Form 8-K filing with the SEC, detailing the company's registration information and compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. It includes the date of the report, the company's name, jurisdiction of incorporation, and IRS identification number. The section also lists various securities registered under the Act, including common stock and senior notes with their respective trading symbols and exchange listings. Additionally, it provides options for the registrant to indicate if the filing meets specific regulatory obligations, such as written communications or pre-commencement communications.

children.title: 2023 Annual Meeting Voting Results and Proposals
children.summary: This section details the results of PepsiCo's 2023 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on May 3, 2023. It includes the election results for 15 directors, the ratification of KPMG LLP as the independent auditor, and advisory votes on executive compensation and its frequency. Additionally, it reports on the defeat of several shareholder proposals, including those for an independent Board Chair and various transparency reports. The section provides specific vote counts for each proposal, highlighting shareholder preferences and decisions.
